title: A WO demo keeps the template's pages and fills them from the restaurant's own posts, deterministically
steps: S1: plan the pages of five released templates (ja-restaurant, ja-impact, ja-spa, ja-vega, Tracy Base) against the content of one restaurant's real posts.
S2: make content items from 284 real captions of five restaurants.
S3: answer the create door's pages question from a brief, and build a brief from collected posts.
expect: S1: ja-restaurant keeps 8 of 13 pages (one menu layout, one contact page, no sample pages), Tracy Base keeps 6 of 6 on EmDash (pricing kept with its layout since 26/10/2026) and 10 of 23 on Joomla, its Contact under Resources kept; every page taken off has a reason; the menu holds dishes, never a job advert, a match night or a joke; a past event or offer goes only to events/offers.

S2: footers, feed bait and keyword lists are cut; a post said twice is one item unless its numbers differ; job adverts, giveaways, closures, greetings and other-language posts are left out; when an event runs comes from its words, a weekly night is unknown, never active.

S3: pages answered = the plan's kept pages (no answer when all are kept); the brief has content items and is valid; the menu page shows the restaurant's posted dishes on the site (fill 'dishes') with or without a menu link, never a button to the live menu, and with no posts it is fill 'dishes' with no items.
evidence: PR 1460; on stand wo3 (19/10/2026) builds kept ja-restaurant 13→4, ja-vega 17→2, ja-spa 7→2, tracy-base 6→2 pages because pagesOf used the brief's 3–5 page sitemap as the keep list; E2E on stand wobrief 19/10/2026 (ja-restaurant j6 kept exactly 8, 5 unpublished; Tracy Base j6 lost resources/contact before e539649ea1); EmDash Tracy Base hand-off on wobrief: Home/Menu/Services/Blog/About all restaurant content, /pricing 404
fence: pagePlan keeps by default and writes why a page goes; contentPool never adds a word to a post

tests: a template keeps its pages: one of each kind, without the samples and variants a demo ships
every page taken off says why
on real feeds the menu shows dishes, never a job advert, a match night or a joke
a past event or offer is never a dish, a story or a blog post; the menu takes posts about food, not about a match night
the footer a page repeats under its posts is cut from every body, and its links are kept as evidence
two posts alike in words but not in their date, price or place stay two items
a job advert, a giveaway or a contest is never content
when an event or an offer runs is read from its words, never from the day it was posted
a pricing page keeps its layout: neutral without a collected price, the collected prices when the brief has them
a page is known by its own name before its section: Contact under Resources is the contact page
a menu page shows the restaurant’s dishes on the site, with or without a menu link; never a button to the live menu
a history page without an about page starts from the best story; a gallery without photographs comes off
an EmDash page carries no path: its id is not always its route (services_page is served at /services)

history: 24/10/2026: 07879554a8 (22/10/2026, product owner): the menu page shows the dishes on the site and never links to the restaurant's live menu, which took the visitor off the demo; 'a menu page shows the menu link when there is one, the page’s own dishes when not' was rewritten to the test now named.

26/10/2026 (#1742, product owner): pricing, team, FAQ, careers and donations pages keep the template's layout instead of coming off; 'a page the plan takes off is named with its reason in the notes' was rewritten to the pricing test now named.
